title: executive-daily-priorities-alex-2026-03-06.json
content:
Daily scratchpad — Alex Kim (exec, quick notes + to-dos)
Date: 2026-03-06

Top 3 for today:
1) Executive sync w/ product + infra (10:00) — align on Dedicated capacity rollout timeline and commit sizes. Need final ask for sales (500k/month) by EOD so finance can draft initial SOW. Prep: ask Priya for numbers on committed vs. actual utilization (Jira ENG-4521).
2) Customer escalation with AcmeHealth (13:30) — private deployment data residency question. Confirm audit log delivery window and KMS options. Action: have SRE bring sample audit log schema and compliance note.
3) Review Redwood Optimize pilot results (16:00) — initial report shows 18% token-cost reduction but slight latency tail increase. Decide go/no-go for expanding to 3 more customers.

Meeting prep / talking points:
- Exec sync: One-slide ask: committed capacity product brief + revenue forecast for Q2. Emphasize predictable throughput and migration plan for top 5 customers. Ask: what fallback policy do we want if Dedicated pool spikes? (auto-burst vs. degrade non-critical routes)
- AcmeHealth: bring prior POA with legal & compliance (link above). Confirm whether they require HSM or KMS integration; if HSM, need SOW addendum.
- Optimize review: show per-route cost delta and request engineering mitigation plan for tail latency (suggest probabilistic batching and KV cache tuning).

Open follow-ups (short list):
- Follow up with Priya (finance) on committed-volume sensitivity analysis — due Friday.
- Ping Marco (infra) to finalize burst-capacity pricing calc and update pricing page draft.
- Ask Product to prioritize shorter rollout window for canary A/B (2 weeks) — file: CONFLUENCE Q1 rollout doc.

Personal to-dos (quick wins):
- Approve Dedicated contract template changes (legal) — review redlines before noon.
- Add two eval prompts to Optimize test set that capture long-context behavior (Socratic convo + code snippet).
- Send 1:1 prep notes to Sofia (topics: career ladder, lead hiring).

Notes from yesterday (raw):
- Ran through customer support thread re: streaming disconnects — appears to be network flakiness (region us-west-2). Need SRE to run trace for 2026-03-04 09:00–11:00 window. Ticket: SUPPORT-997.
- Quick idea: expose per-route latency SLOs in Console and allow per-route fallback model configuration (helps SaaS customers control cost vs. quality). Drafted product brief — very rough.

Risks / things to watch:
- Dedicated capacity commitments may lock us into GPU gen for 6 months — coordinate with release-engineering to ensure compatibility with upcoming quantized kernels.
- Optimize expansion might regress quality for code-generation workloads; require eval gating.

Misc notes / snippets (for later composition):
- "Canary window should be small enough to detect regressions but large enough to capture tail latency anomalies — propose 3% of traffic for 7 days."
- Reminder: update investor FAQ on mechanical reliability numbers (p99 latency, uptime SLA) before next board packet.

Quick links / references (copy these into meeting slides):
- Q1 OKRs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EXEC/Q1+OKRs
- Dedicated pricing draft: GH PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/pricing/pull/87
- Optimize pilot dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/optimize/pilots/acmehealth

End-of-day checklist:
- Send summary email to execs w/ decisions and open action items (CC: Priya, Marco, Sofia).
- Update ticket ENG-4521 with final numbers and link to SOW draft.
- Block 90 mins tomorrow for deep work on investor packet edits.

(Notes-to-self: keep this doc short. Move finalized items to Confluence and attach artifacts.)
